description.value: Pat Quinn's Restaurant & Bar is a full-service restaurant and bar set within the Tsawwassen Springs golf development, offering views of the North Shore mountains and manicured greens. A hockey-heritage theme runs through the menu — kids' items carry names like 'Face Off Fries' and 'Centre Ice Mac N' Cheese' — backed by an extensive BC and international wine list and a craft cocktail program. Located just 5 km from the Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal, it makes a natural pre- or post-ferry meal stop for cyclists traveling the BC coast route.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 73m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active with 'Father's Day 2026' content and a functioning reservation/online-order system, confirming the business is open. Address (5133 Springs Blvd, V4M 0A6), phone (604-948-1123), and website URL all match between OSM and the website. Takeout is confirmed by a prominent 'ORDER NOW - PLACE YOUR ONLINE ORDER HERE!' prompt; GF and vegetarian options are confirmed by explicit 'GF' and 'V' labels on the pre-set menu; no bike-specific amenities, washroom details, or water refill are mentioned on the website, and the OSM internet_access=wlan tag is not corroborated by website content.
concerns: OSM primary name is 'Pat Quinn's' but the website and OSM name:en tag consistently use 'Pat Quinn's Restaurant & Bar' — OSM record may benefit from a name update.
OSM internet_access=wlan tag is not confirmed by website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active full-service restaurant clearly open to the public with a functioning website, current menus, and upcoming event listings; well-positioned near the Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal for touring cyclists.
